title: tenant.v1 definitions
description: The scalar shapes the tenant.v1 sections share. Not a document: a section references these by $ref.

name.description: One bare name, never a pattern: a glob in a name is a grant to everything it matches, including what does not exist yet.

host.description: One DNS name, never a wildcard.

redirectUri.description: An https URL, or a plain-http loopback URL for a native client. No wildcard: a pattern in a redirect is an open redirect.
